name: map-pane
description: Drive a live web map (built on the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript) from the shell: geocode places, add GeoJSON, GeoPackage and services, style and label them, change basemaps, take screenshots. Shows the map in a Ghostty split.

interface.shortDescription: A live web map in a terminal split
defaultPrompt: Open the map and go to Austin, Texas.
Add this GeoJSON to the map with a legend.
